searchText: hello all 👋 qq on 7251, does it allow partial deposits too? e.g. I already have a validator running in 0x02 and I got some spare eth. Can I just send to the deposit contract to increase my effective balance? Yes sir I'm wondering if is there's anything in the beacon state that can be used to prove that a certain deposit was already dequeued and processed. Is `eth1Data.depositRoot` the way to go? And will it work with 6110?
